Resolution /

Title
A Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, 
Florida, approving the grant funding agreement by and between said 
Community Redevelopment Agency and the City of Tampa, Florida, for 
construction of renovations and improvements to the event lawn and other 
facilities at Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park, which is located within the 
boundaries of the Downtown Community Redevelopment Area; authorizing 
execution of the Grant Funding Agreement by the Chair of the CRA and 
attestation by the CRA Secretary; providing an effective date.

On February 12, 2026, the Community Redevelopment Agency approved supporting the 
development of Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park project in the amount of $5.5 million over a two 
fiscal year period. Expected enhancements to the community through this project include site 
prep/demo; site furniture; event lawn and terrace drainage; irrigation improvements; 
reinforced concrete pavement; addition of canopy trees/palms; and new sod/soil. All funds 
contributed by the CRA to the project shall be spent within the boundaries of the Downtown 
Community Redevelopment Area.

This resolution provides for a grant funding agreement between the Community

improvements at Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park in the amount of $5,500,000 within the

agendaItems.background:
The Tampa CRA Board previously approved an annual budget line item dedicated to strategic property acquisition within the West Tampa redevelopment area. Over the past year, the City of Tampa’s Real Estate Department has actively scouted suitable properties for redevelopment, focusing on opportunities that align with fair market value and community objectives.

On February 17, 2026, the West Tampa Community Advisory Committee (CAC) formally requested that Tampa CRA and City Real Estate staff investigate the potential purchase of the liquor store located at 1947 West Main Street.

The Tampa CRA staff recommends that the CRA Board approve the acquisition of the property at 1947 West Main Street and authorize the execution of all necessary closing and transfer documents.

City of Tampa

Department: Community and Redevelopment Agency

ContactMia Dorton 813-274-8643
SubjectA Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, 
Florida, adopting a budget for the 2027 fiscal year, beginning October 1, 2026, 
and ending September 30, 2027, for said Community Redevelopment Agency
Resolution / 
Ordinance 
Title
A Resolution of the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Tampa, 
Florida, adopting a budget for the 2027 fiscal year, beginning October 1, 2026, 
and ending September 30, 2027, for said Community Redevelopment Agency; 
providing funding for the separate redevelopment trust funds administered by 
the Community Redevelopment Agency; recommending to Tampa City 
Council that said 2027 Fiscal Year Community Redevelopment Agency 
Budget be included in the City of Tampa 2027 Fiscal Year General Operating 
Budget; approving the supplementary material received relating to said 2027 
Fiscal Year Community Redevelopment Agency Budget; making findings; 
requiring that the 2027 Fiscal Year Community Redevelopment Agency 
Budget together with the approved supplementary material be submitted to 
the Hillsborough County Board of County Commissioners within 10-days after 
the final adoption of the 2027 Fiscal Year Community Redevelopment Agency 
Budget; authorizing adjustments for the carry-over 2026 tax increment 
revenues consistent with the adopted budget; providing an effective date.
BACKGROUND:
This resolution adopts the Fiscal Year 2027 annual Community Redevelopment Agency 
budget in the amount of $94,287,438 within the Community Redevelopment and General 
Fund.
FISCAL IMPACT: Yes
FISCAL IMPACT STATEMENT:
This resolution adopts the Fiscal Year 2027 annual Community Redevelopment Agency 
budget in the amount of $94,287,438 in accordance with requirements set forth under Florida 
Statutes Chapter 163, Part III. within the Community Redevelopment Funds.
